title: UC Santa Barbara Deep Learning Visual Prosthesis Research
snippet: Researchers from UC Santa Barbara and international partners published a study in Neuron demonstrating that deep learning can make future visual prostheses, like a bionic eye, more precise and responsive by predicting brain activity patterns.
